purpose: Determine whether fixed depth reweighting or a tiny decoder-feature readout improves agreement with released Studio donor labels across one held-out public surface; not an unread-scroll search or independent ink validation.
amends: IDEAS.md package 1: 16 parent proposal reduced prospectively to three physical donor parents, one each for fitting, calibration and testing, with 16 fixed contexts per parent.

model.state: All parameters frozen, every module eval, inference_mode; verify normalization buffers unchanged.
model.base_model_training_exposure: Unknown for these donors; only the newly fitted heads have a documented donor holdout.

splits.context_selection: Fixed public geometry/published coordinate metadata or calibration annotation support only; neither test-label classes nor any model output may select or replace contexts.
splits.test_labels: Do not download or decode before both depth-order heads and calibration thresholds are written to and hashed in readout_freeze.json.
splits.historical_selection_bias: The published 9B/814 candidate parents were originally sampled requiring some ink. Our farthest-point selection did not decode held-out classes, but the test set remains historically label-enriched.

sampling.native_input: Released uint8 high-resolution surface slabs of 65 fine planes; these are not native coarse-acquisition scans.
sampling.resampling: Exact separable voxel-volume box integration of piecewise-constant native uint8 cells; round-nearest ties-even once to uint8; divide by255 exactly once. No clipping, per-image scaling, padding or extrapolation.
sampling.categorical_labels: Nearest source label cell: floor((target_index+0.5)*9.6/9.36); Studio0unknown/1background/2ink.
sampling.geometry_policy: Require every released geometry-mask cell intersecting the complete physical 64 by 64 input-cell rectangle to be nonzero. Lower label-grid indices=floor(origin*9.6/9.36); upper exclusive indices=ceil((origin+64)*9.6/9.36). This is a mesh-support proxy, not proof of acquisition validity. Drop incomplete predefined contexts before inference in both depth orders, report them and do not replace them.
sampling.source_support: All required source chunks must exist and all target volume cells must lie inside source/crop support. Missing chunks fail, never fill. Hecate's nonzero-column support is retained for common scoring across heads; it is not an acquisition-validity audit.
sampling.deduplication: Score each labeled source pixel at most once per physical parent and depth-order arm; first frozen context then row-major ordering wins.
sampling.label_and_geometry_integer_arithmetic: Implement 9.6/9.36 exactly as40/39: nearest label index=((2*i+1)*20)//39; footprint lower=(origin*40)//39; upper=((origin+64)*40+38)//39. This fixes categorical boundary ties and avoids an extra mask row from floating-point ceil.

depth_order_interpretation: Source-order primary, reversal sensitivity separate. Each order has a separately fitted frozen readout and calibration threshold. Never select an order using held-out results; reversal is not an ink-absent control.

readouts.baseline: Exact released 2D logit reconstructed from cached features/logits and released attention weights, validated against official forward on synthetic input. No scalar calibration: positive affine calibration leaves AP and the quantile operating point unchanged.
readouts.depth: One global nonnegative vector of 16 weights summing to 1 and a scalar bias, fitted to volumetric logits. Mean class-balanced logistic loss plus 0.01/2 times squared distance from uniform weights. No per-context depth search.
readouts.features: Mean decoder features over fixed depth planes 6:10; 64 channels per scored pixel. StandardScaler fitted on selected training rows only, then L2 logistic regression C=1, solver=lbfgs.
readouts.sampling: Choose equal ink/background counts without replacement using seed20261122 after support filtering and deduplication. Both depth orders use identical label coordinates where support matches.
readouts.fit_failure: Report convergence and constraint status; invalidate failed arms and do not retry or tune. Retain valid arms. Fewer than 16 training pixels per class makes fitting unassessable; this is an execution minimum, not a statistical sufficiency claim.

evaluation.threshold: Sort calibration background scores descending; threshold=background[floor(0.01*Nbackground)], then select STRICT score>threshold. Ties cannot raise empirical calibration FPR above 1%. No background makes the operating point unassessable.
metrics: FPR and recall at frozen calibration threshold
evaluation.aggregation: Report each retained context and pooled physical parent. Do not treat contexts or pixels as independent replicates or report independent-parent confidence intervals. AUROC and AP require both classes. A missing class makes the corresponding class-conditional metric unassessable.
evaluation.primary_comparisons: On source-order held-out PHerc0814, compare depth and feature AP and tail precision with the unmodified baseline on identical pixels. These are two exploratory comparisons. Retain both and all reversal-arm results.
evaluation.interpretation: One held-out physical parent cannot satisfy the original three-of-four-parent gate or establish promotion. No rule here permits immediate unread-scroll deployment or a prize claim.

limitations: Three physical donor parents, only one held-out parent: contexts and pixels are not independent replicates.
Studio labels include teacher/model-assisted judgments and unknown regions; agreement is not independent ink or readable-letter truth.
Inherited Hecate exposure to these donors is unresolved; only new readout fitting is donor-separated.
Fine-source box-averaged CT does not reproduce the noise, energy or transfer function of native coarse CT.
Prior source-volume uint8 intensity mapping is undocumented; preserve the released values and make no raw-radiometry claim.
Geometry and nonzero masks are support proxies; depth reversal is an orientation sensitivity test, not a population false-positive control.
No unread image access, candidate review, legibility result, organiser submission or prize claim is authorized by this runner.
Published candidate coordinates are historically label-enriched; observed prevalence and review precision do not estimate those quantities in an unread atlas.
source_integrity: Model, code, labels, geometry masks and manifest are hash-pinned before execution. Bucket CT chunks are mutable public objects with no known prior content hash: record canonical URL, transferred bytes and SHA256 on acquisition. Verify live Zarr metadata against its frozen hash. Do not describe chunks as immutable pre-pinned inputs.
audit: Require a full forty-character public freeze commit. Save source-acquisition receipts as chunks arrive, feature progress after every forward, a hashed readout+threshold freeze before held-out labels, and a sanitized failure receipt without automatic retries.
